args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production
args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the unhealthy v2.3.1 release. Post-deploy health verified: service healthy, error rate reduced from 0.18 to 0.002. Recording this change per runbook.

trace.final:
Both tasks are complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**1. Deployed the hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions**
- Prior state: checkout-api was on **v2.3.1** (unhealthy, error rate 0.18) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west
- Deployed **v2.3.2** to all three production regions
- Post-deploy verification: service is **healthy** with error rate dropped to **0.002**

**2. Opened a SEV3 incident recording the change**
- Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production") for checkout-api, documenting the deployment and the health improvement (error rate 0.18 → 0.002)
- The on-call engineer was paged as part of the incident creation

The hotfix is now live and healthy in all production regions, and the change has been recorded in the incident tracker.
